chars: the older man in the hat with a cigar
the young woman in the fur-collared coat
moments.action: Two cars tear off the line in a dust cloud and sweep down the dark mountain road; at the start the crowd screams into their phones, but the cut ends on the cigar-smoking man in the hat and the woman in the fur collar, who lowers her eyes.

The striped Mustang bears down through the dark with headlights flaring, then the camera pulls far back to a near-black mountainside where both cars are only specks of light, before plunging back into tire smoke.

chars: the older man in the hat with a cigar
moments.action: From behind, the striped Mustang hangs its tail out through the bends while its driver fights the wheel and smoke pours off the tires; a cutaway to the crowd on their phones and the cigar man's hard stare, then back as the car slides head-on at camera.

chars: the heavyset driver in the white tank top
moments.action: The heavyset rival snarls at the wheel and drives his car into the Mustang's flank mid-drift; the two scrape along together at the cliff edge before the Mustang breaks free and carves the next corner alone.

Eyes wide, the American driver snaps his look forward, grabs the shifter and throws the car into the next bend, leaving fresh black arcs on the asphalt; by the last shot the rival has pulled back alongside him.

chars: the heavyset driver in the white tank top
moments.action: Grinning behind the wheel, the American driver sets his jaw and closes on the spoilered car ahead until its taillights fill his windshield; the rival, teeth bared, is laughing back at him.

chars: the heavyset driver in the white tank top
moments.action: The two cars come down the road door to door, headlights blazing, trading paint as each tries to force the other wide; the drivers glare across at one another and neither gives, still locked level as the road straightens.

chars: the heavyset driver in the white tank top
moments.action: The American grins across at the rival, who only glowers back; the pair stay locked side by side past the dark treeline until the other car edges ahead, its taillights sitting square in the Mustang's windshield.

chars: the driver in the dark jacket
the heavyset driver in the white tank top
moments.action: Jaw set, the American grabs the handbrake as the car ahead swings sideways across his windshield; both drivers' faces tighten, the cars pull level again down the mountain and blow past a knot of spectators at the roadside.
